tools.description:
Returns recent entries of the hash-chained audit trail, newest first.

Use this to answer "who changed what and when": every read, sync, and write through this server is one entry carrying the tool, the action, the target (spreadsheet/sheet/range), the before and after values for writes, the Workiva operation URL, and the timestamp. Filter by target to trace one cell, for example target "ss-1/sh-1/B3".

The full chain can be integrity-verified by the operator (workiva-mcp audit verify): every entry hashes the previous entry, so any tampering with a stored row breaks the chain at that sequence number. This tool exposes the entries; verification stays an operator-side command so clients cannot rewrite history through the MCP surface.
tools.name: workiva_audit_trail

tools.description: Compares two immutable snapshots by stable server-owned field IDs using the selected server-owned materiality policy.
tools.name: workiva_compare_periods

tools.description: Writes every field in a previewed change set after the person approved it, using the change set ID and confirmation token. Call it only after workiva_prepare_section returned a change set and the person explicitly approved the preview.
tools.name: workiva_confirm_change_set

read_back.description: value read back after the write

tools.description: Writes previously staged section text into the report document after the person approved the preview. Call it only after workiva_stage_section_text returned a preview and the person explicitly approved it.
tools.name: workiva_confirm_section_text

workiva_section_id.description: Workiva section ID; empty if section creation is uncertain

tools.description: Read-only discovery or bounded lineage over the tenant-scoped persisted relationship graph. Provider discovery/refresh is not enabled unless a verified exact-scope provider capability is configured.

direction.description: Lineage vocabulary: upstream, downstream, or both. Default both. Ignored for discover.

idempotency_key.description: Required after authentication; scoped to trusted tenant, actor, tool, and operation.

include_documents.description: Default false; only an approved read-only document capability may honor true.

max_depth.description: Lineage traversal depth. Default 3; absolute server cap 8.

max_edges.description: Traversal/edge response bound. Default and absolute server cap 5000.

max_nodes.description: Traversal/node response bound. Default and absolute server cap 1000.

operation.description: Required server vocabulary: discover or lineage. Conditional rules are server-enforced.

refresh.description: Default false. False is explicitly read-only; true requests a complete exact-scope refresh and requires the refresh capability.

tools.name: workiva_discover_relationships

status.description: completed, partial, unsupported, spike_required, denied, error, idempotency_in_progress, idempotency_replay, or idempotency_conflict.

tools.description: Exports exactly one authorized assurance subject as a manifest-v2 package with authoritative canonical JSON and an optional safe CSV derivative.
tools.name: workiva_export_evidence

tools.description:
Returns the current value of one mapped field, identified by its exact field name.

Use workiva_search_fields first when you only have a natural-language reference such as "scope 2 energy"; it resolves those to field names. When the cached read is still fresh the value comes from the local snapshot cache with no Workiva API call; otherwise the field's range is read live from the API and the cache is refreshed. The response includes the field's spreadsheet, sheet, range, type, description, the value, and when it was fetched (fetched_at, RFC 3339).
tools.name: workiva_get_field

tools.description:
Discovers the Workiva spreadsheets and sheets currently available to the authenticated client.

When a Workiva client is configured, this tool reads the live spreadsheet and sheet catalogs, including files that are not mapped locally. In demo or no-client mode it falls back to the local mapping store.

Use this tool to discover which spreadsheet_id and sheet_id values to pass to workiva_read_range or workiva_sync_mapping. Live discovery only identifies files and sheets; local semantic mappings are still required by workiva_search_fields, workiva_get_field, and workiva_update_field.
tools.name: workiva_list_spreadsheets

tools.description: Prepares one report section from its section recipe, returning findings, narrative facts, verbatim blocks and a change set preview. Call it first when a consultant asks to update a section, before staging any section text.

section_id.description: section ID of the section recipe to prepare

tools.name: workiva_prepare_section

source.description: where the new value comes from

items.description: approved display form of the value, accepted by the number guard

prior.description: prior period value, canonical decimal string

summary.description: change set summary, one line per item

tools.description:
Reads a range of cells from a Workiva sheet and returns the values as a grid of rows.

Args:
- spreadsheet_id: the spreadsheet ID, found via workiva_list_spreadsheets.
- sheet_id: the sheet ID within that spreadsheet.
- range: A1 notation such as "B3" or "B3:D10".

Every call fetches live data from the Workiva API and refreshes the read cache, so recent values are also available to workiva_get_field and workiva_search_fields. Formula cells return their calculated value. Values are returned in Ones scale, matching the Workiva API.
tools.name: workiva_read_range

tools.description:
Searches the semantic field mapping for fields matching a natural-language query.

Call this tool FIRST whenever the user refers to a report value in plain language, such as "scope 2 energy", "water consumption", or "turnover". It resolves those references to mapped field names with their exact spreadsheet, sheet, and cell range, which you then pass to workiva_get_field for the value or to write tools.

Matches come from field names and their aliases. Results include the field's range, description, and, when a fresh cached read exists, the current value. If nothing matches, try rephrasing or list connected spreadsheets with workiva_list_spreadsheets.
tools.name: workiva_search_fields

tools.description:
Captures an immutable, typed snapshot of an approved server-owned report revision and named period.

The server resolves all approved fields and reads Workiva directly without using the read cache. Empty field_ids selects all required fields. allow_partial defaults to false. consistency defaults to best_effort; revision_pinned fails unless the active provider proves that capability. The request never supplies authoritative report values.
tools.name: workiva_snapshot_report

tools.description: Stages the narrative blocks and verbatim blocks for a section in the report document and returns a preview, after the number guard checks every number. Call it after workiva_prepare_section, once the narrative blocks are drafted from the narrative facts.

verbatim_id.description: verbatim block ID, required for verbatim blocks

tools.name: workiva_stage_section_text

verbatim_id.description: verbatim block ID, required for verbatim blocks

summary.description: markdown preview of the staged text

tools.description:
Discovers fields from a two-column "mapper" sheet and upserts them into the mapping store.

Reads the sheet live: the name column holds human-readable field labels, the value column holds the cells those labels refer to. Every row from start_row on becomes one field whose name is the label normalized to snake_case (for example "Scope 2 Energy (kWh)" becomes scope_2_energy_kwh) and whose range is the value column cell of that row. Rows with an empty name are skipped.

Use this after the reporting team edits the mapper sheet, or to bootstrap a new spreadsheet. Afterwards workiva_search_fields and workiva_get_field resolve the synced names, and workiva_update_field can write them with confirmation. The sync itself is recorded in the audit trail.
tools.name: workiva_sync_mapping

tools.description: Stages, confirms, acknowledges, or reconciles a typed value transfer. Bulk phases are disabled. Single-transfer phases require a configured transfer service backed by a verified durable fence.

classification.description: confirmed_applied, confirmed_not_applied, conflicting_value, still_unknown, or provider_evidence_inconsistent.

idempotency_key.description: Required after authentication; scoped to trusted tenant, actor, tool, and phase.

max_cells.description: Bulk-stage request bound; absolute server cap 100.

max_rows.description: Bulk-stage request bound; absolute server cap 100.

phase.description: Required server vocabulary: stage, confirm, acknowledge, reconcile, bulk_stage, or bulk_confirm.

tools.name: workiva_transfer_value

status.description: staged, machine_verified_visual_ack_pending, visually_acknowledged, ack_rejected, reconciliation_required, reconciled_not_applied, stale_source, stale_target, write_rejected, write_failed, write_outcome_unknown, partial_reconciliation_required, feature_disabled, unavailable, denied, idempotency_in_progress, idempotency_replay, idempotency_conflict, or error.

visual_state.description: pending, visually_acknowledged, mismatch, not_visible, or not_checked.

tools.description:
Writes a new value to one mapped field, identified by its exact field name.

This tool is two-phase by default so a human approves every write before it reaches Workiva (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight):

1. Call with just name and value. Nothing is written. The response carries the current value (before), a preview of the new value (after_preview), and a confirm_token that is valid for 5 minutes and single use.
2. Show the before/after preview to the user. When they approve, call the tool again with the same name, value, and the confirm_token. Only then is the batched editCells write sent to Workiva, and the mutation is recorded in the audit trail with before and after values plus the Workiva operation URL.

The confirmation requirement can be disabled by the server operator (require_write_confirmation: false); when disabled a call without confirm_token writes immediately, still fully audited.

Values are written in Ones scale regardless of the cell display format. After a successful write the snapshot cache is refreshed so subsequent reads return the new value.
tools.name: workiva_update_field

tools.description: Deterministically validates one immutable server-owned report snapshot using its approved closed rule set. The provider is never called.
tools.name: workiva_validate_report
